blocks.text:
Praia da Pipa is in the state of Rio Grande do Norte, about 70 km south of Natal. Until the 1970s, it was a small fishing village. Surfers and travellers then discovered Pipa, drawn by its beaches, natural surroundings and peaceful life by the ocean.

The coast combines white sand, clear water, tropical vegetation and sheer cliffs about 10 metres high. Pipa has many hotels, restaurants, bars, nightclubs and small shops. It has become one of the region’s best-known beach destinations, while tropical vegetation, cliffs and long stretches of sandy shore still surround it. Dolphins can be seen in the coastal waters.

There is no fixed sightseeing programme today. After the long journey through Rio, Iguazu and Maranhão, there is time for the ocean, walks and relaxation.
